status.why: EUR-Lex shows the EU's own metadata ('unknown (pending notification) or not yet in force') and Article 30 sets the rule; the Treaty Office chart of ratifications is not stored, so the count of consents is not confirmed. A secondary web page (babl.ai) claims the threshold was crossed in August 2025 with entry into force on 1 November 2025; that is not an official source, conflicts with the stored EUR-Lex metadata, and was not judged on.

date_last_updated.why: null: the earlier value 2026-05-15 was the EU deposit, which is not an amendment of the instrument.

summary_claims.claim: Article 16(4): each Party assesses the need for a moratorium or ban for certain uses of AI systems
Article 3(4): national defence is outside the scope

scope.note: AI-specific treaty on human rights, democracy and rule of law; in scope with no note.

note: All fields checked against the OJ text of the Convention (EUR-Lex HTML, rendered and PDF), Council Decisions 2024/2218 and 2026/1080 and the book.coe.int page. Title, CETS No. 225, opening date, legal force and the summary claims are supported. The status 'Adopted, not yet in force' rests on EUR-Lex metadata and Article 30; whether five consents including three CoE member States exist is held only by the Treaty Office, which is not stored (403). One targeted search found no official page showing entry into force; a secondary site claims 1 November 2025 and was not relied on. The run leaves the status as published, so it does not hold back the corrections.
